annotations.text:
Option A (Halo) is now the real hero, at the top of the full page and on mobile.

The logo is the high-resolution file, cropped to the artwork and colour-reduced so it stays light enough to ship — 58 KB instead of 273, with no visible banding.

Download links are placeholders; v0.1.0 has no release behind it yet.

Outfit (7) is set — in the nav on both the desktop page and mobile.

The rest are kept as a record of what was considered. Headlines stay Instrument Serif and body copy stays IBM Plex Sans; only the wordmark changed.

At the bottom: two quieter treatments, still open if you ever want the name to recede further behind the mark.

Everything that wasn't chosen, kept for reference.

B, C and D are the other three hero treatments. Terminal and Blueprint are the two original whole-page directions, which still carry the older 'review your own code' positioning.
